review.subtitle: Bulova Marine Star automatic 44 mm, rose-gold tone case, blue ring and dial, blue silicone strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Built from Bulova's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference).

Modelled: rose-gold case with faceted lugs and crown guards, blue 24-sided outer ring, brushed rose-gold bezel with the 24 V notches on its edge and six blue screws, applied Roman numerals and logo (traced from the render), rings round the sub-seconds and the open heart, sword hands with lume and the open slot, red sub-seconds hand, fluted crown.

From the photo maps: ridged blue dial, chapter ring with minutes, BULOVA, Marine Star, 200 m, Automatic 21 Jewels, the sub-seconds track, the open-heart movement and the blue silicone strap with the house curl.
Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 12 mm case.
